name: chunked_sgmv_expand
description: Chunked LoRA expand with signature chunked_sgmv_expand(x, weights, batch_info, slice_offsets, max_slice_size, base_output). x is [S, n_slices*r], weights is [num_loras, output_dim, r], slice_offsets is [n_slices+1], and base_output is [S, output_dim]. batch_info supplies seg_indptr, weight_indices, lora_ranks, scalings, permutation and optionally max_len. For each segment b with nonzero rank, for each slice i, add scaling[w] * (x[rows, i*r:(i+1)*r] @ weights[w, slice_offsets[i]:slice_offsets[i+1], :].T) into the corresponding base_output rows. Return a newly allocated output tensor, initialized as a clone of base_output, with the same shape and dtype; base_output and the other inputs are not modified. The suite exercises bfloat16 with one or three slices, scalings, and identity or shuffled permutations; max_slice_size is the launch tiling bound.
